name: Cslib.Turing.SingleTapeTM.map_toCompCfg_right_step
lines: ⊢ Option.map (tm1.toCompCfg_right tm2) (tm2.step cfg2) = (tm1.compComputer tm2).step (tm1.toCompCfg_right tm2 cfg2)
⊢ Option.map (tm1.toCompCfg_right tm2) (tm2.step { state := state, BiTape := BiTape }) =
(tm1.compComputer tm2).step (tm1.toCompCfg_right tm2 { state := state, BiTape := BiTape })
⊢ Option.map (tm1.toCompCfg_right tm2) (tm2.step { state := none, BiTape := BiTape }) =
(tm1.compComputer tm2).step (tm1.toCompCfg_right tm2 { state := none, BiTape := BiTape })
⊢ Option.map (tm1.toCompCfg_right tm2) (tm2.step { state := some q, BiTape := BiTape }) =
(tm1.compComputer tm2).step (tm1.toCompCfg_right tm2 { state := some q, BiTape := BiTape })
